item.title: State licensure delay pushes back NPS superintendent's start
item.description: Norfolk Public Schools has postponed the start date for incoming Superintendent Dr. Jeffrey W. Rose due to a processing delay with his state licensure. Rose was originally scheduled to begin his new role on Monday, Feb. 23, 2026.
